;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2017 Congolese police decapitation attacks]]
**Authorities find the remains of two missing U.N. investigators—former Swedish politician [[Zaida Catalán]] and U.S. national Michael Sharp—in a shallow grave in the province of [[Kasaï-Central]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-un-idUSKBN16Z1FL (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-39418277 (BBC)] [http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=56449#.WNswYzFT7-D (UN News Centre)]

;Business and economy
*Police investigate the discovery of human [[feces|excrement]] in cans of [[Coca-Cola]] in a [[Northern Ireland]] bottling facility. None of the contaminated product left the facility. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2017/mar/28/coca-cola-police-human-waste-drinks-cans (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Cyclone Debbie]]
**A [[Tropical cyclone scales#Australia and Fiji|Category 4]] severe tropical cyclone travels over the [[Whitsunday Islands]] and crosses the coast of [[Queensland]], Australia, near the town of [[Airlie Beach, Queensland|Airlie Beach]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-03-28/bom-warning-cyclone-debbie-hours-from-hitting-north-queensland/8391174 (ABC)]
*Over the last week, a [[meningitis]] outbreak has killed at least 140 people in [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-39418275 (BBC)]
*All 141 people on board [[Peruvian Airlines Flight 112]] escape when the aircraft crashes on landing at [[Francisco Carle Airport]], [[Jauja]], Peru. [http://avherald.com/h?article=4a6d72d8&opt=1 (The Aviation Herald)]

;International relations
*[[Georgia–European Union relations]]
**[[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]'s visa-free regime, which allows travel to most [[Member state of the European Union|member states]] of the [[European Union]], with the exception of [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] and the [[United Kingdom]], enters into force. [https://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-eu-visa-free-travel-/28395173.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
*[[Brexit]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] [[United Kingdom invocation of Article 50 of the Treaty on European Union|signs a letter invoking]] [[Article 50 of the Treaty on European Union]]. Its notification to the [[European Council]] tomorrow will formally begin the UK's withdrawal from the [[European Union]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-39422353 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*A Belgian Court in Brussels declares that [[Delphine Boël]]’s case against former king [[Albert II of Belgium]] is inadmissible even though [[genetic testing]] has proved that her legal father Jacques Boël is not her biological father. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170328220739/http://royalcentral.co.uk/europe/delphine-boels-case-declared-inadmissible-by-belgian-court-79359 (The Royal Central)]
*[[Simone Gbagbo]], the former [[First Lady of Ivory Coast]], is acquitted of [[crimes against humanity]]. She remains in prison for a previous conviction for undermining state security. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-39426160 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Proposed second Scottish independence referendum]]
**Lawmakers in the [[Parliament of Scotland|Scottish Parliament]] vote in favor of holding a second independence referendum for the country within two years. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/03/scottish-parliament-backs-independence-referendum-170328161749063.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[List of executive actions by Donald Trump]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump|Trump]] signs an executive order undoing former President [[Barack Obama|Obama]]'s [[climate change]] policies. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-39415631 (BBC)]

;Science and technology
*Accounts of sightings of animals thought to resemble the extinct [[thylacine]], the largest known [[Dasyuromorphia|carnivorous marsupial]] of [[Holocene|modern times]], prompt a search in the [[Far North Queensland|Far North]] of the Australian state of [[Queensland]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2017/mar/28/tasmanian-tiger-sighting-search-thylacine-queensland-australia  (''The Guardian'')]

;Sports
*In [[association football]], and as [[2018 FIFA World Cup qualification (CONMEBOL)|CONMEBOL qualification]] for the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]] continues, the [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]] forward [[Lionel Messi]] is banned for four matches, five and a half hours before kickoff in his team's match against [[Bolivia national football team|Bolivia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/39423000 (BBC)]
